new.title: WR-509. `SmExtent1d::ContainsPeriodicValue` sets a value just past an interval's start, given a period up, to the start, so a very short ellipse arc inverts every point to its start
WR-755. The merge reads two faces as coincident when they only share a tangent edge, so a fillet against a fillet a hair apart is classified on the wrong side

WR-756. `MergeIntoObject` keeps a vertex where it stood when its tolerance ball holds the other point, so the vertex can lie more than XSectTol3d off one of its faces and `SmVertex::AssertValid` test 1 fails

WR-757. `SmCPGlobalSolver::LocalSolve` culls a span's end answer as "in the next segment" while it skips that segment as zero length, so a point whose foot is at an interval end a rounding past a knot gets no solution
WR-761. `SmIsoCurve::CalculateContinuities` reports the fixed direction's knots, not the curve's
WR-764. `SmGlobalSolver` culls projected extrema in different units from its objective
WR-766. `SmTopologySolver::MayContainAnswer` culls projected extrema in unscaled units and without tolerance
